topics.title: Anthropic billing split June 15: programmatic usage credit pool

No rollover; resets each billing cycle; per-user (CI jobs cannot pool credits across committers)

Credit is NOT auto-applied: must be actively claimed via Claude account settings before June 15 reset (Anthropic sending claim email)
Optional overflow billing ('usage credits'): if disabled, API calls fail hard once monthly credit exhausted; if enabled, overflow billed at standard API rates

Billing split went live June 15 2026; developer workaround: switching non-reasoning steps (formatting, summarization, simple code review) from Opus 4.8 to Sonnet 4.6 cuts credit burn ~3-4x; per-user cap means CI GitHub Actions credits cannot be pooled across committers

topics.title: OpenAI Deployment Simulation: replaying real conversations for pre-release safety eval
key_facts: Published June 16 2026; technique strips assistant response from recent production conversations and regenerates with candidate model before release
Analyzed ~1.3M de-identified conversations spanning GPT-5 Thinking through GPT-5.4 (August 2025 - March 2026); 20 undesired-behavior categories tracked
Aggregate result: median multiplicative estimation error 1.5x (true 10/100K -> estimated 6.7-15/100K)
General technique applicable to any deployment-time property, not only safety; complements rather than replaces adversarial red-teaming
Technique is reproducible: could be applied to logged assistant conversations to estimate regression rates before model swaps

topics.title: NVIDIA Ising: open-source AI for quantum error correction and calibration
key_facts: Launched April 14 2026; two components: Ising Calibration (VLM automating quantum processor calibration, days to hours) and Ising Decoding (error-correction models)
Ising Decoding: 2.5x faster and 3x higher accuracy than pyMatching (current open-source standard) for error-correction decoding
Released on GitHub, Hugging Face, build.nvidia.com; integrates with CUDA-Q and NVQLink QPU-GPU interconnect
Early adopters: IonQ, IQM, Infleqtion, Harvard, Cornell, Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory, Lawrence Berkeley National Lab
Targeted at hybrid quantum-classical workflows; not a general-purpose LLM
